title: Don't suggest restoring the data branch when the ancestor query itself fails during an export refusal
outcome: Don't suggest restoring the data branch when the ancestor query itself fails during an export refusal
acceptance: export_basis_mismatch distinguishes `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit code 1 (not an ancestor) from any other failure (timeout, exit 128); on any other failure the refusal names a neutral remedy (inspect the branch, or export --rebuild), never 'restore the data branch', shown by a test that injects the query failure on a descendant HEAD
